config.stage1_training: all 20 identities, fit rows only (frac <= 0.6): per-task mean/sd, PCA basis, WCCN whitening. Fold-invariant, computed once.
config.stage2_enrollment: prototypes from the 20-k enrolled identities' fit rows only (frac <= 0.6); k_proto centres per identity
config.stage3_deployment: identification (argmax over enrolled prototypes) and rejection (best-match score below the fold threshold) on the 0.6 < frac <= 0.8 block
config.threshold_rule: tau = quantile(enrolled identities' known best-match scores in the eval window, 1 - a); only enrolled identities calibrate it
